mmf.government_fund_aum_note: Government/Treasury funds are the largest MMF subclass by AUM. This is a buyer-BASE size, not a measure of actual Treasury securities held -- government funds also hold repo (often Treasury-collateralized but not itself a Treasury security) and agency debt.
